'''star wars ccg player 2 The Death Star is THE ULTIMATE POWER IN THE UNIVERSE''' is a [[Dark]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[star wars ccg player 2|star wars ccg player #2]]
* '''Published:''' 30 November 2002 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Coruscant]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Set Your Course For Alderaan / The Ultimate Power In The Universe|TA-D-setyourcourseforalderaan.gif|label=Set Your Course For Alderaan}}
* '''Strategy:''' Set Your Course For Alderaan
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:PCor SYCFA starwarsccgplayer2 DS 2002 TheDeath.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

== Strategy ==

With the objective allowing you to search through your reserve deck and pull out any card with Death Star in title you begin to pull out your sights and three Death Star Gunners.  While you are doing this you also look to see if the Superlaser is in your reserve deck or force pile; if it is in your force pile be sure to draw it up.  A Million Voices Crying Out allows you to pull Comence Primary Ignition into your hand from lost pile or from your reserve deck.  You will be able to blow up Alderaan on your 7th turn at the latest, I have done it in three turns.  Once you flip you objective you would be able to Retrive three force whenever you play a Unique Star Destroyer.  If you Play Chiraneau on a Star Destroyer on Anoat or Naboo then you gain a force drain bonous of 9 per turn.  If you play Admiral Ozzel on a Star Destroyer then you can play other Star Destroyers for 4-6 force.  Kitik Keed'kak, P-58, Colonel Dvod Jon, Darth Vader, and Mara Jade are all in the deck so you could get a quick beat down at a sight if your opponent leaves himself/herself vulnerable, or you can simply use them to defend yourself at the Death Star sights.  The seven Imperial Tooper Gaurds are for defending the Death Star.  I think that everything else is self explanitory.
